d: The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing the organization's accounting operations, ensuring compliance with financial regulations and accounting standards, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting management with timely financial reporting and analysis. The role supervises accounting taks, manages month-end and year-end closing activities, and contributes to financial planning, budgeting, and internal control processes.
q: Bachelor's degree in accountancy, finance, business management, or a related area, specifically an accounting graduate.
Minimum 3 years in a senior accountant, chief accountant, or supervisory accounting position.
Experience with multinational companies or complex business environments is preferred.
Proven experience in financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, and audit coordination.Strong understanding of accounting principles
Proficiency in using financial software and ERP systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, i.e., Excel, PowerPoint, Word.
Experience working with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.)
Working experience in shared services set-up or with other cultures.
Arabic and English both oral and written.
